title: Blended Learning: Transforming Education in the Digital Era
passage:
Blended learning, which strategically combines traditional classroom teaching with digital online resources, is revolutionizing secondary education globally. Instead of passively listening to lectures, students can now watch instructional videos at their own pace at home and use classroom time for collaborative problem-solving and discussions.

This modern pedagogical model offers multiple advantages. Digital learning software provides immediate feedback on interactive quizzes, allowing students to identify knowledge gaps instantly. Furthermore, online platforms grant equal access to vast digital libraries and multimedia learning materials for learners in remote areas.

However, successful blended learning requires reliable high-speed internet connections and adequate digital literacy from both educators and students. When implemented thoughtfully, blended learning empowers students to become autonomous, lifelong learners.

questions.prompt: What is blended learning as defined in the text?
options: B. Combining traditional classroom instruction with online learning

C. Longer school hours every day
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu 'requires reliable high-speed internet connections and adequate digital literacy'.
